personality: 1 iOS-Native Clean (Modified per user brief: White background, Poppins font, gradient buttons without borders/shadows)
personality_one_liner: A clean, modern, and highly legible interface designed to build and explore family history seamlessly.

spacing.rule: Use generous padding around content. Forms should be single column with labels above inputs.

dont's: Skip glassmorphism to keep the white background flat and modern per user brief.

screens.name: Onboarding
screens.purpose: Introduce the app and log in the user via Google to become the admin/root_node.

states.error: Failed login toast or inline error message with retry

screens.layout: Full-bleed hero image at the top with a vertical gradient scrim (transparent to #FFFFFF) at the bottom 40%. Below the image, title and description text using Poppins. At the bottom, a sticky primary CTA gradient button (Google Login) spanning full width minus padding. Safe area handled.

screens.name: Tree (Pohon)
screens.purpose: Main canvas to display the family tree from root_node using SVG/Canvas with two-finger pan and zoom.

states.empty: Illustration of a family tree with a button to add the first root node if not already created

screens.layout: Full screen canvas using react-native-gesture-handler for zoom/pan. Top header contains 'Export PDF' button. Nodes are circular photos (borderRadius 999). Each node has a colored border based on gender/admin (Male=#3B82F6, Female=#EC4899, Admin=#F59E0B) and shadow (no extra solid borders). When a node is selected, 4 small circular floating buttons [+Father], [+Mother], [+Spouse], [+Child] appear around it. Connector lines: solid for blood/marriage, dashed for adopted, red for divorce. Tapping a node opens a detail bottom sheet or modal.

screens.name: Search (Cari)
screens.purpose: Find a person in the entire family tree.

states.empty: Empty state document illustration with 'No results found'

screens.layout: Sticky search bar at the top (surfaceTertiary background, pill radius). Below it, a FlatList of people. Each row has a circular avatar, name, and relationship/job subtitle. Chevron on the right to indicate navigation to detail.

screens.name: Add (Tambah)
screens.purpose: Full data form to add or edit a person in the tree.
screens.layout: Scrollable single-column form. Segmented control or custom tabs at the top for 'General', 'Marriage', 'Divorce'. Form fields have labels above inputs. Includes photo upload area, date pickers for dates, and a checkbox for 'Adopted Child'. Sticky primary gradient CTA at the bottom inside KeyboardAvoidingView.

screens.name: Settings (Setting)
screens.purpose: Manage app preferences, backups, and collaboration.
screens.layout: List of functional rows: Multi-language toggle (ID/EN, default ID), Backup (JSON export), Collaboration (Invite via email). Rows use surfaceSecondary background, rounded corners (md), and grouped sections.

onboarding_hero.alt: A group of family members holding hands representing connection and genealogy

empty_search.alt: Empty list document abstract for search state

empty_tree.alt: Green abstract shape representing a family tree concept

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly use the 'Poppins' font for all text components as explicitly requested by the user.
Main buttons MUST use a vertical gradient (e.g., brandPrimary #F59E0B to #EA580C) via expo-linear-gradient with NO border and NO shadow (borderWidth: 0, elevation: 0).
Background color must be white (#FFFFFF) across main screens.
The 4 bottom tabs must be: Tree (Pohon), Search (Cari), Add (Tambah), Settings (Setting).
Node Colors: strictly use Male=#3B82F6, Female=#EC4899, Admin=#F59E0B for node borders/shadows.
Tree logic: Use solid lines for blood/marriage, dashed lines for adopted children, and red lines for divorce.
Implement the 4-direction seed generator: when a node is tapped, display 4 small [+Father], [+Mother], [+Spouse], [+Child] buttons positioned Top, Bottom, Left, Right around the circular node.
For the Tree Canvas, utilize react-native-gesture-handler (PinchGestureHandler, PanGestureHandler) for zooming and panning.
Ensure Default Language is Indonesian (ID), toggleable to English (EN) in Settings.
For the Birthday reminder, set up local notifications 1 day before the birth_date of living people.
Collaboration feature: Admin invites via email, others become editors (can add but not delete).
All images overlaying text must use a gradient-to-dark scrim to ensure minimum WCAG contrast.
Follow the specific layout patterns for single-column forms with sticky bottom CTAs inside KeyboardAvoidingView.
